title: Make the token check strict
summary: Kill the loose compare that makes every 0e hash equal, and fill in the in_array third argument.

files.content:
<?php

final class Token
{
    private const REVOKED = ['0e462097', 'deadbeef00'];

    public function verify(string $given, string $expected): bool
    {
        if (in_array($given, self::REVOKED)) {
            return false;
        }

        return md5($given) == md5($expected);
    }
}

turns.user: review says == is not ok here. Token::verify. fix it

assistant.body: With ==, two strings that look numeric get compared as numbers, so any pair of md5 outputs starting with 0e compares equal. Switching to hash_equals gives a strict comparison and a constant time one.

turns.user: what about the in_array? pretty sure someone slipped a 0 past that once

assistant.body: Good catch. Without the third argument in_array compares loosely, so two 0e values match each other there as well. Passing true makes it strict. One loose comparison left in place is enough to sink the rest.
